name: Discord
summary: Discord is a communications platform built around persistent communities, combining text, voice, video, and live interaction for gaming, creators, and broader interest groups.
overview: Discord operates a persistent-communities platform centered on text, voice, video, and live interaction. Its investment case rests on preserving community engagement while building durable paid and advertising revenue streams.

facts.label: Latest disclosed financing
facts.note: The 2021 round was widely reported at roughly a $14.7 billion valuation.

bull_case: Persistent communities can create a defensible communication layer for users and creators.
bear_case: Monetization must mature without undermining the community experience.
latest_round: September 2021: $500M funding round at reported $14.7B valuation

intelligence.description: Discord operates a communications platform built around persistent communities, voice, text, and live interaction.
company: Discord operates a communications platform used by gaming communities, creators, and increasingly broader interest groups.
The company was last widely reported at a $15 billion private valuation and was reported to have filed confidentially for a U.S. IPO in 2026.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Discord is an important test of whether a large community network can monetize advertising and paid products without compromising the user experience that built its scale.

changed.text: Discord announced a new Series I funding round led by Dragoneer.
Bloomberg reported a confidential U.S. IPO filing.

takeaways: Discord's last widely reported private valuation was $15B.
IPO timing and monetization are the main catalysts.
Community retention remains central to the model.
